book.name: GALATABO
book.title: GALATABO Galatabo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Non japahoni ta patoronen jahuen baque hanijati yohihi quesca qui. Baque pishca parihax ta jahuen papan joni quescapah qui, jahuabi hihboyamahi. Jahuen papan jahuaborabo jatihibi hihboyahnoxihqui bi jahuabi hihboyamaparihi.
Haxemanicahton haxemahah ta haxehiqui. Hanijanicahton yohihah, nincaquin, jahuen papan yohini nete noconon caman.
Jascapahbo tah non japahoniqui. Cristo qui hinamehyamaparixon tah non baque pishca hahcajaquin noquen nincati joibo nincapahonihqui, haxehax noquen xenibo hihni quescari jihueyahnoxon.
Non jascapahbo jihuetai bi ta jahuen raanti nete nocoscaiya jahuen baque Papan raannishqui. Jaan raanah ta haibaan baquexo sca cainnishqui. Moisesnin yohini quesca ta jaxonnishqui.
Noque ta hahxonnishqui, Moisesnin joi nincaqui non jihueyamascanon, Papan baquebo sca.
Jahuen yoshin siri ta noquen jointi janin Papan jananishqui, jaan yohuanmaha non Papan hihnon, noquen joinbi. Jaa copi honannahue, Papan baquebo man hihqui.
Hinabo tah man hihyamascai, Papan baquebo sca. Jahuen baquebo jaan mato hihmahah cah man jahuen baqueboxon jan hinantijani man bihtihi.
Shinan rabeyahpabo qui Pablonen masa shinanai
Noquen Papa Dios honanyamaparixon tah man huetsajaquin shinanpahonihqui, huetsabo dios hihqui man shinanah bi tah man jaamajapahonihqui.

Papa Dios tah man honanscaniqui. Hashoan ponte yohuani tah hen Papan ta mato honannishqui, hih hen jatihi. Jascapahboscaxon, jenquetsahpahi man japahoni quesca sca hahan hanitima shinanbo man bihribicatsihquin? ¿Jenquetsahpahi man yanca res yohuanai joi chibanrihbicatsihquin?
Netebo, hoxnebo, baritianbo, jenetianbo, jascapahbohiya tsinquinicabo tah man qui Papan noque siri jisnon hihquish tsinquiti.
Jaa copi tah hen tiromajaquin shinanai. Yanca bi res cahran hen Papan joi mato nincamaniquin hih tah hen jai.
Mato tah hen hihti yohihi, heen huetsabaan. Hea hihqui quescanahue. Mato quescapah tah hen janiqui. Hea jano cahiya tah man nincanihqui.
Hisinax copi tah hen mato qui banenihqui. Hisinax banexon cah hen Papan joi siri mato nincamani.
Hea hisinyahpa que bi tah man hea rahninxonma Johue hahniqui. Hea tenexon tah man Papan yonoti yohiquin hahcajaxon hea Johue hahniqui. Jesucristo yohiquin hahcajaxon hea sirijaquin bihquin.
Hen yohihah tah man hihti jenimaniqui. Hahtipahxon tah man maton bero tsecaxon hea hinanquehannihqui. ¿Jahua copi sca man shinan huetsajahin?
¿Hen mato pontejaquin yohihah man maton rahui sca hea jisin?
Mato tiromajanoxon ta Maton tah man sirijahi hihcaniqui. Bahi xehpoquin hahcajaquin ta mato mayamacatsihcaniqui, huetsa bahi man chibannon hihxon.
Sirijahiton yohihah ta siri qui, Mian tah min sirijahi hahquin. Jaa ta jatihibi tian yohihah siri qui, heen baquebaan, hea mato janin hihquiya, hen jano hihyamahiya, jascarihbihi.
Man Criston shinan bihnon tah hen hihti queenai, heen baquebaan, hisini quesca tah hen jai.
Jenquetsahpa shinanya man quin hihxon tah hen masa shinanai, heen jananbi sca mato yohinoxon hea jano rahmabi hihpahinon.
Agarya Sara
Moisesnin yohini joi chibancatsihxon hea yohinahue. ¿Nea jahuen huishani joi man honanyamahin?
Abrahanen ta rabe baque janishqui, huetsa cahen jahuen xobohoxon teexonnicah haibo quihah, huetsa cahen jahuen haibo quihah.
Huesti cahen jaanbi jahuen hina haibo qui baquejanish. Huetsa cahen jahuen haibo quihah, jaa jayaxihqui Papan yohinih.

Jaa haibo rabe janí quesca ta rahma jaibo qui. Rabejaquin Papan yohini quesca tah qui. Jan yohimenoni ta Sinaí mahchi janinxon noquen xenibo yohinishqui, hinapan baquebo sca jaábo. Agar ta jaa hiná qui, jahuen jane.
Agar ta jaa Arabia mai janin Sinaí mahchixon yohini joi quesca qui, rahma jai Jerusalen quesca. Jahuen baquebo ta hinabo qui, jaton mama quescapahbo.
Huetsa ta quiquin Jerusalen qui, hinama, jaa cahen noquen mama.
Huishani joi jai quesca tah qui:

content.text: Baqueyosma ta baque bihyamanish bi hihti jenimascaiqui. Jahuentianbi camitaxma bi ta jenima behuahihqui. Baquejoma hihnish bi ta hicha baqueyahpascaiqui, beneyahpa haibo mahuinbahinquin

content: hihqui jaa huisha joi.
Mato tah man Papan hinanni baquebo qui, jan hinantijani. Isaac quesca tah man qui, hea huetsabaan.
Jaa hina haibaan baquebaan neateman Dios Yoshiman baquebo tiromajapahoni quescajaribiquin ta rahma jacanihqui.
¿Jaabo yohiquin jahuaja hen Papan janishquin? Jaa baqueyabi hina haibo potahue, hinapan baquen ta hinantijani baque betanbi heen hinanti bihtimahiqui, hahquin.
Jaa copi honannahue, hea huetsabaan. Hinapan baquebo tah non hihyamahi. Quiquin haibaan baquebo tah non qui.
